documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported consolidated total income growth of 58.60% year-on-year for Q2 FY27 and 47% growth in total income from operations for H1 FY27, reaching INR 194.9 crores. Management guided for more than 30% revenue growth for both FY27 and FY28, driven by domestic expansion and exports to the USA and Europe. To support growth and manage labor availability, the company plans to invest around INR 9.5 crores in automation and R&D across Menon Alkop and Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months. CapEx continues to be funded via internal accruals without taking term loans. Menon Bearings Limited presented its Q2 & H1FY27 financial performance, reporting consolidated revenue from operations of Rs 100.88 crore in Q2 FY27, up 58.6% YoY, and Net Profit of Rs 14.73 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth to be more than 30% for FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company is taking efforts to achieve INR 500 crore in turnover next year or the year after.
guidance.quote: Before, last two years back, INR 500 crore looked at 2029 -- 2029-2030. So we are taking a lot of efforts so we can reach INR500 crore next year. Most likely next year or maybe year after that.

guidance.claim: Management stated that INR 360 crores is a conservative revenue guidance figure for the year that they will stick to.
guidance.quote: INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: The company has set an internal conservative target of 20% plus year-on-year growth.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Management is targeting revenue of INR 100 crores for Alkop this year and around INR 125 crores next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports to reach 37% of total revenue by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM business grew by almost 50% and exports increased by more than 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: We can see there is a growth as compared to the same quarter last year. There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: Visits to Europe generated positive interest and RFQs from European companies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Europe visits were quite positive. Some companies invited us, some we took appointments and went. So a lot of RFQs coming from that side.

demand_outlook.claim: Schedules from tractor companies are increasing despite drought-like conditions in Maharashtra.
demand_outlook.quote: But in spite of that drought-like situation, so far as Maharashtra is concerned, and maybe other states as well in throughout India, but at the same time it is surprising that our schedules from tractor companies are increasing --

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

demand_outlook.claim: EV share in the Alkop business currently stands at around 4% to 5%.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, we are at around 4% to 5% EV.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months for automation and R&D.
capex_expansion.quote: And I will not say only for automation and R&D how much we are investing, but next two years in Menon Bearings and Alkop, 12 months, around INR5 crores in Menon Alkop and around INR4.5 crores in Menon Bearings.

capex_expansion.claim: Management estimates a payback period of 2.5 to 3.5 years for its automation and R&D investments.
capex_expansion.quote: So this is the investment we are getting, and roughly ROI will be in the next 2.5, 3 years, should be the return on investment on this investment what we are doing.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores this financial year to expand capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Alkop alone will incur a CapEx of around INR 4 crores for this year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: Additional future CapEx is expected to yield an asset turn of around 2.5.
capex_expansion.quote: See, whatever future CapEx that we are going to do, the additional CapEx will have asset turn of around 2.5.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA for the first six months of the financial year increased by 77%.
margins_costs.quote: So the EBITDA for the six months, it has increased by 77%, PBT by 92%, PAT by 89.55%, and cash and bank balance including mutual funds INR 25.69 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs increased substantially with tin up 72%, copper 50%, and steel 12%.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Segment EBITDA margins are 30% to 35% in Brakes, 18% to 19% in Alkop, and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
margins_costs.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins reached 21% plus for bi-metal, almost 21% for Alkop, and 25% for brakes during Q1.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%. And now, for this quarter, in brakes, we have achieved 25%.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis, management expects to sustain margins of around 20% to 21% over time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that prices for consumable carbide tools have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company expects additional consolidated business of around INR 30 crores for FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Management estimates additional business of INR 131 crores for FY28.
orders_capacity.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%, with '28-'29, the growth driver, we are having the list of all customers also from whom we are estimated to get the business, RFQs are there, and discussions are going on, commercials have been finalized.

orders_capacity.claim: Additional business of INR 157 crores is expected for 2029, excluding INR 35 crores of potential European business.
orders_capacity.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated Q1 sales increased by 36.57% year-on-year to INR 91.79 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Now coming back to the consolidated performance of the company, on a consolidated basis, the sales increased to INR91.79 crores as compared to INR67.21 crores last year, same quarter, registering a growth of 36.57%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that peak revenue from the bi-metal bearing segment alone can exceed INR 400 crores with existing infrastructure.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx has been financed entirely through internal accruals without taking term loans over the past six months.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals without taking fresh loans.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: US market outlook carries uncertainty due to potential changes in tariffs and exit policies.
risks_headwinds.quote: US has been a little bit volatile because of Mr. Trump's comments and what he's saying, tariffs, exit policies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Longer shipping durations from the Strait of Hormuz conflict have occasionally forced the use of air freight, impacting working capital.
risks_headwinds.quote: But like you said, because Strait of Hormuz and war, it's taking longer. So sometimes air freight is required, so it affects working capital a little bit.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed over the last three months due to war and backlogs in the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material prices have increased by 20% to 25%.
risks_headwinds.quote: You see, even after increasing the raw material prices by about 20%, 25%, still, not only we have sustained, but our margins have increased further.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets revenue growth of more than 30% for FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

management_commitments.claim: Management is working to reach a turnover of INR 500 crore over the next year or two.
management_commitments.quote: Before, last two years back, INR 500 crore looked at 2029 -- 2029-2030. So we are taking a lot of efforts so we can reach INR500 crore next year. Most likely next year or maybe year after that.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
management_commitments.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

management_commitments.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores in the current financial year to increase capacity by 25% to 30%.
management_commitments.quote: you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

management_commitments.claim: Management is targeting Alkop revenue of INR 100 crores for this year and around INR 125 crores for next year.
management_commitments.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects railway business in brakes to reach INR 25 crores to INR 30 crores within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: with this in the first year itself, we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
